result.title: When Source-Domain Validation Fails to Transfer: A Staged Study of Hyperparameter Selection
result.comment: 25 pages, 2 figures. Expanded version of work accepted to the AAAI-27 Student Abstract and Poster Program
result.summary: Hyperparameters for an unseen domain are often selected using held-out examples from the available source domains. Withholding entire source domains during validation seems to better reflect deployment shift, but does this produce better selections on independent targets? We investigate this question through two complementary studies. A preliminary factorial experiment crosses particle swarm optimization and random search with pooled source validation and a leave-one-source-domain-out mean-minimum fitness on PACS and Multi-Domain Sentiment. The domain-aware fitness does not provide a consistent target advantage. We then separate selector development from confirmation using a shared pool of 64 configurations per task across four image benchmarks. Complete target-performance landscapes on VLCS and Office-Home inform one rule: retain the top 16 configurations by pooled source validation, then select the largest leave-one-source-domain-out mean-minus-standard-deviation score. The rule is frozen before evaluation on TerraIncognita and SVIRO. Across their 14 target domains, its equal-dataset-weighted balanced-accuracy difference from pooled validation is +0.097 percentage points (95% bootstrap interval [-0.685, +0.960]), with five wins and nine losses. Exploratory analyses reveal substantial variation across datasets, target domains, and training seeds. These results do not establish equivalence or a general failure of domain-aware validation. They show that the evaluated source-domain criteria did not establish reliable target gains under the tested protocols, and motivate assessing selection rules on datasets independent of those used to develop them.

AI.brief_summary: 该文研究域偏移下超参数选择：比较池化源域验证与留一源域的最差/均值-方差适应度，并在独立目标数据集上冻结选定规则后确认，发现域感知指标并未带来可靠的目标域收益。
AI.relevance_reason: 其“验证准则先开发、再在独立数据集上冻结确认”的方法学警示，可能可供核查 LVR 中各 latent 机制或超参数在跨基准比较时的选择偏差与结论稳健性，但与视觉推理状态本身无直接联系。
